info.name: Task API - Completed filtering
info.description: Run against a seeded local database containing both completed and incomplete tasks. Requests are read-only. Override baseUrl to verify a deployed API.

exec: pm.test('Fixture includes completed tasks', () => pm.expect(tasks.some(t => t.completed === true)).to.be.true);
pm.test('Fixture includes incomplete tasks', () => pm.expect(tasks.some(t => t.completed === false)).to.be.true);
pm.test('Every task is completed', () => pm.expect(tasks.every(t => t.completed === true)).to.be.true);
pm.test('Returns exactly the completed IDs', () => pm.expect(tasks.map(t => t.id).sort()).to.eql(expected));
pm.test('Every task is incomplete', () => pm.expect(tasks.every(t => t.completed === false)).to.be.true);
pm.test('Returns exactly the incomplete IDs', () => pm.expect(tasks.map(t => t.id).sort()).to.eql(expected));
pm.test('Returns validation details', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Validation failed'); pm.expect(body.details).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });
